description: envrypt reimplements socket-lib's path helpers in Rust (crates/envrypt/src/helpers/node_path.rs). The socket-lib submodule is a SPARSE reference — only the src/paths cone is checked out and tracked for drift, matching .gitmodules sparse-checkout=src/paths. Row kinds + materialization: docs/agents.md/fleet/lockstep.md; schema: scripts/fleet/lockstep/schema.mts.

rows.notes: Rust port of socket-lib's path helpers (src/paths) in crates/envrypt/src/helpers/node_path.rs. Sparse: only the src/paths cone is vendored + counts as drift (matching .gitmodules sparse-checkout=src/paths); upstream commits outside src/paths are not drift. Locked: a socket-lib bump requires re-verifying the Rust port, so it is never auto-bumped.
